newsitem.title: UK: PEARSON SEEKING TO SELL SES STAKE.
newsitem.headline: PEARSON SEEKING TO SELL SES STAKE.

text.p: Pearson Plc chief executive Marjorie Scardino said on Monday that the company was likely to dispose of its six percent stake in Societe Europeenne des Satellites>, the Luxembourg-based satellite company.
Scardino said that Pearson "was looking at exit strategies" for the SES stake.
Finance director John Makinson said that the SES stake had a book value of around 50 million stg but that brokers had said it could be worth up to 120 million if sold as part of an IPO.
SES has been considering a flotation for some time.
